subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): skip malformed legacy import-run files in doctor

question: Should malformed or schema-invalid legacy import-run files remain at their original .json paths and repeatedly trigger doctor, or should doctor preserve them under a quarantine suffix after warning?
rationale: Both choices preserve user data, but they differ in operator action, repeat diagnostics, and whether the legacy migration can reach a completed state; repository history does not establish the intended policy.

options.title: Quarantine rejected files
options.body: Rename rejected records to a reversible suffix such as .invalid after warning so their bytes remain recoverable and later doctor runs do not repeatedly plan the same migration.

options.title: Retain original files
options.body: Keep rejected .json files untouched and require the operator to inspect or delete them, accepting repeated migration warnings until that action occurs.

recommendation.title: Quarantine rejected files
recommendation.body: Rename rejected records to a reversible suffix such as .invalid after warning so their bytes remain recoverable and later doctor runs do not repeatedly plan the same migration.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the migration and archive contract whose terminal behavior needs confirmation.
